name: Return to Nessa
summary: You carry Laird's findings from Auberdine back to Nessa Shadowsong in Rut'theran Village. The journey is an introductory errand that teaches young travelers how to cross between Kalimdor and Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Messenger Across the Sea
sections.body: Laird sends you back across the water with his written observations. He has found stark differences between the fish caught off Darkshore and those near Teldrassil, and suspects the great World Tree changes the local marine life. You can return to Rut'theran Village by hiring a flight from Caylais Moonfeather, the hippogryph master, or by boarding the regular ferry at Auberdine's pier.

sections.title: Curious Bounties
sections.body: Nessa Shadowsong receives Laird's reply at Rut'theran Village and is fascinated by the difference in marine life. Fish near the World Tree grow so large that they bring an immediate boon to local fishermen, though the Kaldorei still do not know why. Nessa plans to share the findings with her fellow villagers. For now, she is content to harvest the abundant sea life and watch for whatever forces may be responsible.

faq.q: Who starts and completes this quest?
faq.answer: Laird, the fisherman in Auberdine on the Darkshore coast, sends you to Nessa Shadowsong at Rut'theran Village, at the base of Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is the fastest way back to Rut'theran Village?
faq.answer: You can fly with Caylais Moonfeather, the hippogryph master in Auberdine, or board the regular passenger ferry from the long pier to Rut'theran Village.

faq.q: Why is Laird studying the fish?
faq.answer: Laird studies the fish because catches along Darkshore differ greatly from those around Teldrassil. He suspects the World Tree's growth and unique energies alter the surrounding wildlife.

faq.q: Does Nessa find out why the fish are so strange?
faq.answer: Nessa does not learn why the fish are so strange immediately. She notes the difference and agrees it deserves further investigation, while sharing the report with the villagers and enjoying the abundant catches for now.
'Flight to Auberdine' comes before this journey, carrying Nessa's original letter from Rut'theran Village to Laird in Darkshore.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest chain?
faq.answer: The chain introduces Teldrassil's mysterious influence on local wildlife and teaches young night elf adventurers how to travel between their island home and the Kalimdor mainland by ship and flight master.

angles.text: As a night elf leaving Teldrassil's boughs for the first time, you take part in your first official errand linking the island haven with the ancient mainland of Darkshore.
As an Alliance traveler, you pass between Auberdine and Rut'theran Village, a maritime gateway linking northern Kalimdor's night elf settlements with Alliance interests across Azeroth.
